method.growth: CS and XP per 60 seconds after an observed active start with no nearby active teammate; includes subsequent deaths.
method.expected: Outer series-held-out predictions; inner series validation selects phase-only averages or regularized context models. Growth context adds current position, neighbor counts, levels, prior economy and own/opponent champion identity; network context uses draft proxies. Selected context must improve inner loss by 1%. Full adjustment is not asserted when phase-only wins.
limitations: No causal credit, support intention, team calls or known enemy vision.
No continuous co-movement between frames; nearby teammates may arrive within the outcome minute.
Lane-wave opportunity, exact matchups and opponent skill are incompletely controlled.
Series bootstrap intervals condition on fitted baselines; multiple comparisons and baseline estimation uncertainty are not covered.
Threshold and both-endpoint sensitivity results condition on the primary expected model without retraining.
Same role and champion do not identify individual ability; sparse players remain explicit.
